title: A new national team: S. Mallesham and Surendra Kumar Pandey elected
author: Editorial Desk
body:
*Photo: BMS new national leadership, February 2026*

In February 2026, the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh announced its new national committee for the term **2026–2029**.

## The office-bearers named in the announcement

- **President:** Shri S. Mallesham (Telangana)
- **General Secretary:** Shri Surendra Kumar Pandey (Chhattisgarh)
- **Finance Secretary:** Shri Anish Mishra (Delhi)

The full committee also includes seven Vice Presidents, six Secretaries, the Organising Secretary and other office-bearers, which are listed on the *Who's Who* page of this website.

## How leadership changes in BMS

BMS is organised in a pyramid of local unions, federations, State units and the national body. Delegates elect office-bearers at the national conference at fixed intervals. The practice of change at the top is a mark of an organisation that does not depend on one person.

## What to expect

The new team inherits a full agenda: the rules under the Labour Codes, the social security of the unorganised and gig workers, the scheme workers' demands and the hosting of the **BRICS Trade Union Forum** in India in 2026.

We wish the new team well. A union grows when karyakartas of every region find a place in it.
